rows.note: Use this when someone sits with their arms and legs spread out.

example.english: I sprawl on the sofa to watch TV, taking up the whole thing.
example.traditional: 我攤住坐喺梳化度睇電視，成個人霸晒成張梳化。
example.jyutping: ngo5 taan1 zyu6 zo6 hai2 so1 faa2 dou6 tai2 din6 si6 seng4 go3 jan4 baa3 saai3 seng4 zoeng1 so1 faa2

rows.jyutping: taan1 daai6 beng2 sik1 faat3 zin2
rows.note: Use this for urban or residential development spreading outward in a disorderly way.

example.english: The suburbs are experiencing sprawl from housing estates, and the infrastructure cannot keep up.
example.traditional: 呢區近郊畀屋苑攤大餅式發展，交通配套完全追唔上。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 gan6 gaau1 bei2 uk1 jyun2 taan1 daai6 beng2 sik1 faat3 zin2 gaau1 tung1 pui3 tou3 jyun4 cyun4 zeoi1 m4 soeng5

rows.note: Use this when things or people are scattered irregularly over an area rather than sitting sprawled.

example.english: The papers sprawl messily across the table, and finding one takes all morning.
example.traditional: 啲文件散落喺張枱周圍，搵一張都要搵成朝。
example.jyutping: di1 man4 gin6 saan3 lok6 hai2 zoeng1 ci4 zau1 wai4 wan2 jat1 zoeng1 dou1 jiu3 wan2 sing4 ziu1

rows.note: Use this for an ungainly person lying or sitting sprawled out.

example.english: They came home and lay in a sprawl on the sofa, refusing to move.
example.traditional: 佢一返到屋企就一副攤屍樣攤喺張梳化度，叫極都唔郁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 jat1 fu3 taan1 si1 joeng6 taan1 hai2 zoeng1 so1 faa2 dou6 giu3 gik6 dou1 m4 juk1
